name: web-gravity-off-course-site-with-pink-horse-rider-and-cloud-cutout
title: Sky-blue course site with giant 'GRAVITY OFF' white and yellow, a leaping pink horse and rider, and a cloud-shaped section edge
whatItIs: A blue gradient hero inside a rounded frame with a nav, huge heavy 'GRAVITY' in white and 'OFF' in yellow, a cutout of a pink horse leaping with a rider in pink, a tagline with pink keywords, a yellow Let's Go button, student avatars with '2K+', a cloud-shaped notch and a white About section with pink emphasis.
whatItMeans: Whimsical and bold; a leaping horse is the literal 'gravity off'.
techniques: Let a cutout break the giant headline.
Use a cloud shape as a section edge.

vocabulary.definition: A cutout overlapping and interrupting a headline.
A headline with words in different colours.
